widgets_values: A locked-camera cinematic martial arts action duel with high framerate clarity and sharp particle lighting. In a misty ancient temple courtyard with cracked stone flagstones, a master martial artist in flowing white robes crosses dual steel daggers overhead to parry a ferocious two-handed downward broadsword cleave from an armored obsidian warrior. The intense physical impact generates brilliant white-hot sparks and dynamic air shockwaves, violently pushing the martial artist backward into a 1.5-meter staggered skid across the cobblestones before stabilizing in a low combat stance. Deep resonant metallic clang echoing across the courtyard with grinding boots scraping on stone.

widgets_values_named.value:
subject_definitions:
<Picture 1> is the character concept design sheet for the celestial lunar maiden archer with long flowing silver hair and translucent gossamer gown.
<Picture 2> is the weapon concept sheet for the blazing phoenix recurve greatbow layered with jagged ruby crystal plumage, a heavy golden sunburst riser, and curved bladed limb tips.
<Picture 3> is the technical specification sheet for GOLIATH-01 Siege Colossus, a 15-meter heavy titanium siege mech with dark armor, yellow hazard stripes, and a glowing cyan-gold chest reactor core.
<Subject 1> is the celestial lunar archer originating from <Picture 1>, featuring cascading silver-white hair adorned with delicate golden flower vines, an ethereal translucent gown of flowing iridescent ice-blue gossamer ribbons accented with golden crescent-moon pendants, standing barefoot with golden anklets, wielding <Subject 2> as a heavy two-handed melee bow-blade in the snow.
<Subject 2> is the colossal phoenix solar greatbow originating from <Picture 2>, wielded by <Subject 1> as a melee bludgeoning and slashing weapon, featuring razor-sharp jagged crimson ruby plumage running along the limbs, a massive reinforced golden sunburst riser, and curved bladed tips that melt falling snowflakes into steam.
<Subject 3> is the GOLIATH-01 Siege Colossus originating from <Picture 3>, a towering 15-meter heavy war mech with weathered dark gunmetal armor frosted with white snow, yellow hazard stripes on the spiked pauldrons and calves, a glowing horizontal crimson visor slit, massive hydraulic leg pistons, and a pulsating cyan-and-gold circular fusion reactor turbine in its chest.
<Subject 4> is the ruined industrial warzone arena buried in powdery snow under a howling winter blizzard, with dense swirling snowflakes, frosted concrete pillars, and freezing arctic mist beneath the dark winter night sky.

summary:
[reference generation] Act 1 (10 seconds): It is snowing. In a howling winter blizzard within <Subject 4>, the 15-meter siege mech <Subject 3> engages in brutal close-quarters melee combat with <Subject 1>. Using <Subject 2> directly as a two-handed melee bow-blade, <Subject 1> horizontally parries a sweeping titanium punch with explosive friction sparks and blasted snow powder, executes a forward supersonic flash step to slice <Subject 3>'s forearm hydraulic lines, vaults into the air to crushingly bludgeon <Subject 3>'s head turret and shatter its crimson visor, and hooks the bladed bow tip into the collarbone to vault smoothly onto <Subject 3>'s broad left shoulder platform.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1> (archer sheet): fully_preserved - silver hair, facial beauty, translucent ice-blue gossamer gown, and golden crescent anklets are completely maintained.
<Picture 2> (weapon sheet): fully_preserved - golden phoenix-wing filigree, crystalline ruby feather blades, heavy riser, and flame ribbons are preserved.
<Picture 3> (mech sheet): fully_preserved - 15-meter massive proportions, dark gunmetal plates, yellow hazard markings, and head turret details are maintained.
<Subject 1> (appears in all shots): fully_preserved - martial two-handed melee weapon biomechanics, parrying balance, and acrobatic vaulting form are preserved.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Subject 1]'s hands in all shots): fully_preserved - bludgeoning impacts, blade edge slicing, and melee friction sparks are preserved.
<Subject 3> (appears in all shots): fully_preserved - heavy hydraulic mechanical weight, crushing attacks, and head trauma destruction FX are preserved.
<Subject 4> (appears in all shots): fully_preserved - snow-covered warzone ruins and howling blizzard atmosphere are maintained.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a hyper-realistic 3A IMAX cinematic winter blizzard action aesthetic with intense cold-steel mechanical impact, falling snowflakes, zero ground-sliding, visceral melee weapon choreography, and dynamic lens flares across a continuous 10-second opening act. It is snowing.
[Shot 1] A cinematic low-angle tracking camera pushes forward rapidly through the snow-covered ruins of <Subject 4> amidst swirling blizzard flurries. The colossal 15-meter siege mech <Subject 3>, with snow dusting its spiked pauldrons, throws a devastating horizontal backhand sweeping punch, its rectangular titanium knuckles screaming through the air to pulverize <Subject 1>. Without backing away, <Subject 1> plants her bare feet in the powdery snow and raises <Subject 2> horizontally with both hands, bracing the thick golden sunburst riser to meet the blow head-on. The colossal titanium fist violently impacts the glowing golden bow riser with an earth-shaking metallic clang, blasting a violent circular shower of white-hot friction sparks and blasted snow powder across the screen. Absorbing the impact momentum, <Subject 1> activates a 0-frame forward supersonic flash step: vanishing instantly with a concussive vacuum pop and a brilliant cyan-and-crimson optical motion blur streak, she reappears on the inside flank of the sweeping mechanical forearm until 00:03.200.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.200, the shot cuts to an upward-tilting dynamic tracking camera. Spinning with razor-sharp momentum amidst falling snowflakes, <Subject 1> swings <Subject 2> like a massive two-handed curved greatsword: the jagged crimson ruby crystal plumage along the bow limb slices violently across <Subject 3>'s forearm hydraulic conduits, shearing through the reinforced steel braiding. Scalding pressurized hydraulic fluid and thick white steam erupt in a violent geyser, instantly vaporizing the surrounding falling snowflakes into swirling steam clouds. Pushing off the severed arm with her bare foot, <Subject 1> vaults vertically ten meters into the blizzard air, performing a full 360-degree acrobatic spin while raising <Subject 2> high above her head with both hands until 00:06.500.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.500, the shot cuts to a dramatic high-angle over-the-shoulder tracking shot. Descending with colossal gravitational force through dense falling snow, <Subject 1> smashes the heavy golden central riser and bladed ruby limb of <Subject 2> directly down onto <Subject 3>'s recessed head turret like an apocalyptic warhammer. The brutal bludgeoning impact caves in the titanium skull armor with a sickening crunch, violently shattering the horizontal crimson visor slit into exploding glass shards and crackling electrical arcs. The titan's colossal head is brutally snapped backward by the strike. In the same fluid motion, <Subject 1> hooks the curved bladed tip of <Subject 2> into a crevice in the titan's collarbone armor, using it as an anchored pivot to hoist herself up and vault smoothly onto <Subject 3>'s broad left shoulder pauldron platform. She lands in an anchored, low predatory crouch with <Subject 2> rested horizontally across her knees, her silver hair whipping in the freezing blizzard as snow flurries swirl around the glowing phoenix bow and the 15-meter colossus reels and groans beneath her at 00:10.000!

overall_soundscape:
Howling arctic blizzard wind and the sizzle of falling snowflakes vaporizing against the molten bow, followed by the deafening concussive crash of titanium knuckles clashing against the divine golden bow riser, a sudden breathless vacuum pop and hypersonic whip-crack sonic boom as the flash step triggers, the high-pitched screech of crystal blades slicing pressurized hydraulic steel hoses, and an earth-shattering metallic crunch as the bow smashes the mech skull, accompanied by glass shattering, electrical arcing, and the heavy pneumatic groan of the staggering colossus.

non_diegetic_music:
A pulse-pounding 160 BPM dark-fantasy cyber-orchestral hybrid score driven by aggressive analog basslines and thundering taiko drums that reach a massive, distorted sub-bass crescendo precisely on the head-smash frame, holding a high-tension suspension chord through 00:10.000.

nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

nodes.title: 💡 T2V Mode Guide (Pure Text)
widgets_values:
### 🥋 KinetiX Combat Bridge (T2V Mode)

**Pure Text-to-Video Combat Enhancement.**

- **No reference images required!** Just write prompt text in the input box.
- **Preset for T2V**:
  - `alpha`: 0.18 ~ 0.25 (Default 0.20 for heavy sparks & recoil)
  - `token_span`: `all` (enhances full sequence)
  - `magnitude_match`: `per_token`
- **Auto Download**:
  - Weights (~16MB) auto-download from Hugging Face on first run.
